previous_statement: Block multiplication gives A_0B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). The amplified compressed product acts entrywise on this one supported block, hence A_0 dot B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X)=E_{11} tensor (h u_Q), using the defining amplified column-Hilbert display. Therefore A_0 dot B-A_0B=E_{11} tensor (h u_Q-X^dagger X), whose norm is exactly ||h u_Q-X^dagger X|| by the canonical operator-space matrix norm.
new_statement: Direct block multiplication gives only A_0B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). Under this shard's exact allowed inputs, the amplification/corner naturality needed to define the relevant compressed product entrywise and infer A_0 dot B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X) is unavailable; likewise, no allowed definition or dependency supplies ||E_{11} tensor z||=||z||. Hence the former compressed-product and norm identities do not follow and are withdrawn; this node provides no bridge from the padded square product to ||h u_Q-X^dagger X||.
